title: Red Hat Insights Advisory
description: Schema for a Red Hat advisory (erratum) representing a security fix, bug fix, or enhancement update applicable to registered RHEL systems through the Insights Patch service.

id.description: The advisory identifier in Red Hat format (e.g., RHSA-2024:1234, RHBA-2024:5678).

type.description: The type of advisory indicating the nature of the update.

synopsis.description: A brief summary of the advisory content.

description.description: A detailed description of the advisory including affected components and changes.

severity.description: The severity rating for security advisories, null for non-security advisories.

public_date.description: The date and time the advisory was publicly released.

modified_date.description: The date and time the advisory was last modified.

applicable_systems.description: The number of registered systems to which this advisory is applicable.

cves.description: The list of CVE identifiers addressed by this advisory.

packages.description: The list of updated package names included in the advisory.

references.description: External references related to the advisory.

reboot_required.description: Whether applying this advisory requires a system reboot.

release_versions.description: The RHEL release versions this advisory applies to.

Package.description: An RPM package included in the advisory update.

evra.description: The epoch:version-release.arch string of the updated package.

summary.description: A brief summary of the package.

examples.synopsis: Important: kernel security and bug fix update
examples.description: An update for kernel is now available for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9. Red Hat Product Security has rated this update as having a security impact of Important.
